member.name: T:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo
member.summary: Build provenance for the running emulator, populated at compile time from GitHub Actions environment variables via [AssemblyMetadata] and surfaced as a touchHLE-style banner at the top of the log.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.CommitSha
member.summary: Short commit hash the build was produced from, or null.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.Branch
member.summary: Branch the build was produced from, or null.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.Repository
member.summary: Repository slug (owner/name) the build came from, or null.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.WorkflowRunUrl
member.summary: URL of the GitHub Actions workflow run that produced the build, or null.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.Configuration
member.summary: Build configuration (e.g. Debug or Release), or null.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.IsOfficialRelease
member.summary: Whether this build is an official release: a Release-configuration CI build from the canonical repository, produced by a push to main or a manual workflow dispatch (matching the CI release job). All other builds (pull requests, forks, feature branches, and local/Debug builds) are considered unofficial.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.Banner
member.summary:
The multi-line banner, e.g.
SharpEmu UNOFFICIAL f11ac59 — https://github.com/sharpemu/sharpemu
Built from branch "main" of "sharpemu/sharpemu" by GitHub Actions workflow run https://github.com/sharpemu/sharpemu/actions/runs/123.
Official release builds drop the UNOFFICIAL tag. Falls back to a local-build line when no CI provenance is present.

member.name: T:SharpEmu.Logging.CompositeLogSink
member.summary: Dispatches each to every child sink. Exceptions thrown by a child are swallowed so one failing sink (e.g. a closed file) cannot silence the others.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.ConsoleLogSink.IncludeExecutionContext
member.summary: Console stays compact by default. Set SHARPEMU_LOG_CONSOLE_CONTEXT=1 to show sequence/thread/correlation information interactively.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.FileLogSink.IncludeExecutionContext
member.summary: Include sequence, monotonic elapsed time, PID/TID, operation/scope and structured diagnostic context in file output.

member.name: T:SharpEmu.Logging.HostSystemInfo
member.summary: Provides best-effort information about the host system.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.HostSystemInfo.CpuName
member.summary: Host CPU name, or a safe fallback when it cannot be determined.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.HostSystemInfo.GpuName
member.summary: Preferred physical GPU name, or a safe fallback when it cannot be determined.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.HostSystemInfo.Summary
member.summary: Returns a concise description of the host hardware for diagnostic logs.

member.name: T:SharpEmu.Logging.LogContext
member.summary: Lightweight ambient diagnostic context. Values flow through async calls via AsyncLocal and are copied into LogEntry only when an entry is emitted.

member.name: T:SharpEmu.Logging.LogEntry
member.summary: Immutable event passed to log sinks. The execution/correlation fields are intentionally optional so existing callers that construct LogEntry directly remain source compatible.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.SharpEmuLog.MinimumLevel
member.summary: Entries below this level are dropped. When a SHARPEMU_LOG_FILE sink is active it only limits the console — the file receives every level. disables logging entirely, file included.
